run: qs ipc call experience set everyday

measure() { out="$1"; hyprctl eval 'hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.cursor.move({x=600,y=400}))' >/dev/null; sleep 1.5; : > "$out"; hyprctl eval 'hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.cursor.move({x=28,y=673}))' >/dev/null; end=$(( $(date +%s%3N) + 900 )); while [ "$(date +%s%3N)" -lt "$end" ]; do qs ipc call debug dump | jq -r '.popout | select(.phase != "closed") | (if .frame == .target then "still" else "moving" end)' >> "$out"; done; }; gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface enable-animations true; sleep 1; measure "$HOME/qa-motion-standard.txt"; hyprctl eval 'hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.cursor.move({x=600,y=400}))' >/dev/null; sleep 1.5; gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface enable-animations false; sleep 1; measure "$HOME/qa-motion-reduced.txt"
